CO’s mission is to ensure that Grab’s marketplace in Vietnam runs smoothly, compliantly, and efficiently every day. For merchant campaign operations, CO works closely with internal teams and Merchants to coordinate operational activities and campaigns, resolve issues, and keep work on track.
